author: Charles H. Risuer
title: The Determination of Scopoletin in Indoor Air
objective: To develop and verify a method for the determination of scopoletin as a particulate marker for environmental tobacco smoke in indoor air.
previous_procedure: A previous procedure (ETS 92-0007) was capable of detecting scopoletin in ETS but suffered from poor recovery from the mixed cellulose ester membrane on which it was collected.
